tools.name: search_google_maps
tools.description: Search Google Maps for businesses/places by keyword and location. Returns name, address, phone, rating, opening hours, and GPS coordinates for each result.

searchQueries.description: One or more search terms, e.g. "restaurants in Delhi" or "dentists in Austin TX".

maxResults.description: Maximum places to return per query (default 20, max 500).
